verdict.rationale: Brex documents its own accounting sync: prepared expense data syncs automatically to Puzzle, with 'one-click' accounting setup and real-time close. The evidence never names QuickBooks, NetSuite, or Xero, and never shows GL account, class, or department mappings that a finance lead controls. Missing for 10: documented QuickBooks/NetSuite/Xero integrations, user-controlled GL/class/department mapping configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration of sync behavior.
